summary: This proposed standard defines a new iCalendar component, VAVAILABILITY, for publishing the available and unavailable time periods associated with a calendar user. It can be used in free-busy lookups, including those using iTIP, so scheduling tools can better understand when a person can actually meet.

eli5.summary: Besides showing when you are busy, this lets your calendar say when you are free, like office hours that repeat every week, so others can find a good time.

questions: how to publish working hours in a calendar
